sentences.en: Gentlemen, allow me to say a few words in greeting.
sentences.zh: 各位先生，请允许我说几句问候的话。

sentences.en: The word that is known to anyone is a greeting.
sentences.zh: 人人都知道的一个词就是问候。

sentences.en: He doesn't know even the proper way of greeting people.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不知道正确的问候方式。

senses.zh: 问候(greet的现在分词)；致敬；迎接
